Chittagonian TTS proof of concept: fine-tuning a Bangla VITS model.
Gradio demo: type Chittagonian text, hear the fine-tuned (boinga) or the baseline voice.
Audit summary: exclusion rules (clean_mask), reports/audit_summary.md, clean clips to hear.
Baseline smoke synthesis: pretrained voices read configs/baseline_prompts.json for listening.
Checkpoint sampler: val prompts per training checkpoint, candidates ranked by eval loss.
Command-line entry point (`boinga`) for data prep, training and demo commands.
Helpers called inside generated Colab cells: run header, cell markers, notes, file checks.
Corpus index: one row per spreadsheet line with its wav, dialect text, translation and split.
Corpus audit: per-clip audio stats and per-transcript text/charset stats for exclusions.
Corpus download: stream the pinned zip to Drive, check size + sha256, unzip once, copy to fast.
Drive API listing of My Drive folders: checks what Drive holds, not what the mount shows.
Record the environment (reports/env.json) and the reproducibility report (reports/repro.json).
Objective check for C10: mel-cepstral distortion (DTW) of each voice vs the real recordings.
Blind A/B evaluation (C10): held-out prompts, A/B/R audio, blind rating sheet, scoring.
Milestone copies: model weights + config of chosen run checkpoints, kept apart on Drive.
Single source of truth for paths: Drive + fast disk on Colab, ./local elsewhere.
Training-data prep: audio transform, leak-free splits, ljspeech manifests, `boinga prepare`.
Pretrained Bangla VITS voices: cache model.pth + config.json on Drive and report their facts.
Interactive blind rating in Colab: play clip1/clip2, score 1-5, save the sheet to Drive.
Move Colab reports into the repo: print files between BEGIN/END markers, parse pasted output.
Upload check of a run's checkpoints: sizes and md5s recorded on the VM, compared on Drive.
Pinned facts: pretrained model ids/URLs, dataset file + sha256, seed and inference scales.
Speaker selection: embed each clean clip's voice (cached per clip), cluster and rank voices.
Voice bank: the baseline and fine-tuned (boinga) voices, loaded once, speaking prepared text.
Minimal seeded synthesis for any VITS checkpoint: load a coqui Synthesizer, say text to a wav.
Text front-end: NFC-only normalise() plus configs/char_map.json for every text the model sees.
OOV report: characters in the selected clips' model text that the base voice's charset lacks.
Fine-tune config: the base voice's pretrained config.json plus logged, reasoned overrides.
Training reports: step time, losses and memory from a run's coqui log; listen to a checkpoint.
Training runner: coqui VITS loader check, fine-tune runs, smoke cleanup, best-model promotion.
